exclusions: Brand name "Shuttlr" inside default texts and the wordmark (identity, not copy)
Date/time format tokens (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm) passed as {format} placeholders
Server-supplied text: push notification title/body, API error `detail`, sport display names, tournament status/format values, consent text
User-generated content (group, game and tournament names, nicknames, descriptions)
Internal identifiers, route names, log messages and thrown Error messages that are never rendered
Backend response strings matched in code (e.g. "Email already registered"); not displayed
